materials.content: An incomplete wax maquette, with the same section of the outer loop broken and missing as the epoxy resin CR 1145. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum)

remarks_post_1999: The Lynes publication listed the date for the original design as 1916, this has been confirmed as an editorial mistake and the record has been updated to the correct designed date of 1946. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2026)
